ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web shown, if the number of humans decreases, what will most likely happen to the supply of fish?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web; the arrow from the sun points to algae, the arrow from algae points to small marine animals, the arrow from small marine animals points to fish, and the arrow from fish points upward to humans, indicating that humans consume or prey on fish. Reasoning: The question asks what will happen to the supply of fish if the number of humans decreases. Because humans are consumers of fish; after humans decrease, the fish preyed on or used by humans will decrease, so the supply of fish will most likely increase.
